verdict.rationale: Self-hosting rendezvous or relay servers is a fair question for a remote-access product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a TeamViewer on-premises or self-hosted relay or broker option. The only related mention is a community user looking for a self-hosted alternative, which is not evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
